figures.finding: For income year 2025 (tax year 2026, the latest scale found) a resident pays federal income tax of 25% to €16,320, 40% to €28,800, 45% to €49,840 and 50% above, after a tax-free sum of €10,910; communes add a surcharge of 0% to 9% of the tax (7% on average, 7% flat for non-residents).
figures.applies: Income year 2025; Deloitte gives the band limits as €16,310, €28,790 and €49,820. The income-year 2026 scale was not found (see blockers). Regional surcharges on the reduced federal tax apply by region of residence on 1 January.

sources.said: For residents of Belgium, communal taxes are levied at rates varying from 0% to 9% of the income tax due. The average rate being 7%. For non-residents, a flat surcharge of 7% is due.
The basic lump sum amounts to EUR 10,910 (income year 2025 (tax year 2026))

figures.finding: An employee pays 13.07% of gross pay with no ceiling, plus a special social security contribution of €9.30 to €60.94 a month (at most €731.28 a year per family); the employer pays about 25% to 27% for a white-collar employee.
figures.applies: 2026. The self-employed scheme and the performing artists' scheme were not read (see blockers).

sources.said: The employee's share of social security taxes is 13.07% of the total gross compensation, with no cap. The employer's share currently varies around 27%.
A special social security contribution is also due, the amount varying between EUR 9.30 and EUR 60.94 per month.
25% of gross salary for “white- collar” employees

figures.finding: Employers withhold professional withholding tax (précompte professionnel) from salaries by the legal scales the tax authorities publish.
figures.applies: Scales not read (finances.belgium.be bot-checks this environment).

sources.said: To calculate the WHT, employers must follow the legal scales as published by the tax authorities.

figures.finding: An organiser in Belgium must withhold 18% professional withholding tax from fees paid to foreign performing artists and athletes, and this withholding is in principle final.
figures.applies: As described in 2020 (a bill to relax it was then tabled); its later fate and the base (net of expenses) were not confirmed from the law.

sources.said: Le régime actuel prévoit que les organisateurs doivent retenir un précompte professionnel de 18% des revenus qui sont versés aux artistes et sportifs étrangers. Ce précompte professionnel est en principe libératoire

figures.finding: VAT is 21% (6% on copyrights and on concerts and performances); a small business with turnover up to €25,000 may be VAT-exempt but must still register.

sources.said: The standard VAT rate is 21%.
Copyrights. Conducting concerts and performances.
SMEs with an annual turnover not exceeding EUR 25,000 may be considered VAT exempt taxpayers, but still must register for VAT purposes.

figures.finding: The income year is the calendar year; the return is filed in the following year (by the end of June, mid-July online), and tax is paid within two months of the assessment notice.
figures.applies: The balance's due date follows the assessment, not a fixed day.

sources.said: The Belgian tax year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
Any tax due must be paid to the tax authorities within two months following the sending of the assessment notice.
Resident individuals must file an annual tax return by the end of June following the tax year

figures.finding: A self-employed person in their main activity pays social contributions of 20.50% of net professional income up to €75,024.54 and 14.16% on the part from €75,024.54 to €110,562.42, with a minimum contribution as if on €17,374.08, paid provisionally on the income of three years before and settled on the year's own income; an arts worker holding the arts work certificate who works outside an employment contract may be covered as an employee (article 1bis), and a self-employed one gets the reduced starter minimum for 8 quarters instead of 4.

artists.article1bis: employee social security for artistic work outside an employment contract, with the certificate

figures.applies: Self-employed in main activity (indépendant à titre principal); contribution year 2026 as INASTI states it on 2026-11-01; the social insurance fund's management fee is not read.

sources.said: En tant qu'indépendant à titre principal, vous payez : 20,50 % sur un revenu professionnel jusqu'à 75.024,54 euros ; 14,16 % sur la partie du revenu professionnel supérieure à 75.024,54 euros et jusqu'à 110.562,42 euros.
Un indépendant à titre principal est toujours redevable d'une cotisation minimale, calculée sur un revenu minimum de 17.374,08 euros.
Donc, vous paierez par exemple vos cotisations 2026 sur base de vos revenus de 2026.
C'est pourquoi vous devez tout d'abord payer des cotisations provisoires sur vos revenus d'il y a trois ans.

L'avantage de l'article 1bis est que le travailleur des arts est assujetti à la sécurité sociale des travailleurs salariés et peut donc s'ouvrir des droits en matière de sécurité sociale (chômage, assurance maladie, pension, etc.).
la réduction des cotisations sociales minimales a été portée de 4 à 8 trimestres.

figures.finding: Copyright and neighbouring-rights income is taxed as movable income at a flat 15%, withheld by the payer, up to €77,220 for income year 2026 (above it, at the progressive rates); the flat cost deduction (50% to €20,590, 25% from €20,590 to €41,180) is from 2026 reserved by the 2026 programme law to holders of an ordinary or "plus" arts work certificate, and others deduct actual costs.
figures.applies: Income year 2026 (tax year 2027); the ceiling and bands are from a secondary source, as finances.belgium.be answers this environment with a captcha.

sources.said: La loi-programme modifiant notamment les règles applicables à la déduction forfaitaire des frais liés aux droits d'auteur et aux droits voisins a été adoptée par le Parlement.

Le gouvernement a décidé de réserver cette déduction forfaitaire aux personnes disposant d'une attestation du travail des arts. Cette mesure concerne les titulaires d'une attestation du travail des arts ordinaire ou plus .

Les personnes qui ont supporté des frais professionnels plus élevés, ou qui ne peuvent pas bénéficier d'une attestation du travail des arts, peuvent toujours opter pour la déclaration de leurs frais réels.

Classés comme revenus mobiliers, ils sont imposés séparément à un taux fixe de 15 %, échappant ainsi à l'imposition progressive des revenus professionnels. Le précompte mobilier, fixé à 15 %, est directement retenu et reversé à l'État par le client.
Montant maximal de droits d'auteur qualifiés de revenus mobiliers – limite absolue. 75 360 € 77 220 €
